entities.summary: Central Cadres Training School of the Workers' Party of Korea is a key party-political educational institution in North Korea responsible for training and preparing the managerial staff of the Workers' Party of Korea and the state apparatus that is part of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea.
